description: NPg Network Development Plan - Thermal Demand Headroom - Portal Format is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. This is a time series version of our NDP Demand Headroom Dataset, designed to produce various graphs and visuals. For a more human readable version of the data, we suggest using the link above to access our other version. This dataset contains the demand forecasting for both our Northeast and Yorkshire licence areas. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Connecting Demand, Network. Its keywords are Demand, Forecast, Network Development Plan (NDP), Extra High Voltage (EHV), Methodology, Network Capacity and Utilisation. The portal shows 2026-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
